world: a ruined gothic castle sunk in a misty valley at dusk, crumbling black stone towers and broken battlements, a collapsed drawbridge over a dark moat, dead twisted trees, overgrown graveyards with leaning tombstones inside the courtyard, tattered banners, pale blue ghost-lights floating in the fog, a cold violet and deep indigo sky with a thin crescent moon

b-wisp.describe: a small wandering will-o'-the-wisp spirit, a floating flame of pale blue and violet fire with a simple round ghostly face of two dark eyes and a small open mouth, wispy flame tail trailing behind, faint sparks drifting around it, hovering low over an old mossy tombstone, timid and lonely expression

b-armor.describe: a towering suit of cursed black plate armor with no body inside, dented and rusted steel edged with tarnished silver, violet ghost-fire glowing through the gaps and the empty visor slit, a long tattered dark cape, gripping a huge notched greatsword with both gauntlets, chains hanging from the shoulders, standing guard in a ruined castle hall

b-lich.describe: a majestic undead lich king, a tall gaunt skeletal figure in flowing layered robes of deep purple and black with gold embroidery, a tall jagged iron crown, glowing violet eyes in a skull face, a long staff topped with a dark crystal and a ring of floating spectral skulls, cold mist and ghostly souls swirling around, raising one bony hand, seated before a broken throne under a huge gothic window
